subject.cedVersion: AP Calculus AB and BC CED (V.1 with Fall 2026 clarifications; 2027 exam: 42 MC/100 min)
subject.designNotes: All AB topics (scope both) plus BC-only topics 6.11-6.13, 7.5, 7.9, 8.13 and units 9-10 (scope bc_only). Topic order is a recommended 1:1 teaching order; sub-keywords and prerequisites are original. Practice weights are per CED MC table; FRQ weights not published numerically.
